derived.claim: Following F32, the recipe's first step 'copy the shipped file to the project's .claude/agents/' is ambiguous in a per-project install, where the shipped file already sits at that path (install.sh:21-22). There the retune is an in-place edit of the installer's own file, so it is not a copy and not a fork. The next --force install silently reverts it. The same word, 'copy', then names two situations with different consequences, and FR-003/FR-004 describe only the global one. Remedy: have the README name both modes in one sentence each: global install means a project copy that shadows; per-project install means edit in place and do not use --force.

evidence.note: The per-project install target is the project's .claude, the same folder the recipe writes to.
FR-003 assumes a distinct copy beside a shipped file elsewhere.

derived.pull_quote: In a per-project install there is no copy to make, only an edit the installer can undo.
